entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-14 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted starting at 10:46 Asia/Shanghai. HF returned an HTTP 200 empty list for Nov 14, a complete 34-paper Nov 13 board and a refreshed 21-paper Nov 12 board with one late member. All raw board members were reconciled. Across sources, 41 new identities were found: 37 arXiv papers, Semipy and three official posts. Three-round scope review recommends one inclusion, 39 exclusions and one evidence deferral. JustRUA qualifies narrowly through its Harness self-improvement experiment for a Nov 13 supplement reviewed on Nov 14; gains of the final static system are separate. Semipy has verified DOI and print/online dates, but its body returns 403 and its version and scope remain unresolved. Three arXiv searches returned zero window records, five RSS feeds returned 58, and checks of 13 GitHub repositories found zero window releases. S2 citations returned 411 window records across 300 identities before rate limits and the deadline; author queries were also rate-limited, so missing coverage is unknown. Of 39 historical version pairs compared, 24 reuse unchanged scope opinions and three have independent scope checks; 12 still require substantive reading. Across the task tables, 349 body-comparison tasks remain. TeleTune, EmbodiedEvo and ECG-RSI enter historical-backlog review at their current versions. Eighteen retries recovered none of nine older externally blocked bodies. The unpublished Harness Repair record and summary have been rebound to official v1 evidence; complete publication review is still deferred, without importing later-version numbers. The already-published 2611.08318 receives only its newly observed HF date, not duplicate publication. DeepMind article dates follow the official page and structured metadata, with conflicting RSS values retained. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection-time review bulletin, with no new papers included today.

entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-15 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 configured sources were attempted starting at 10:34 Asia/Shanghai. HF returned HTTP 200 empty lists for Nov 15 and Nov 14; all 34 members of the latest complete Nov 13 board were reconciled, with no new HF identities or recommendation-date additions. Other sources yielded 16 new candidate identities: three-round scope review recommends seven inclusions, six exclusions and three body-evidence deferrals. Four inclusions belong to the Nov 11 supplement and three to Nov 12 according to official original publication dates; all were discovered and reviewed on Nov 15, not newly published today. Official bodies for three DOI candidates were inaccessible or metadata-only; one original publication date remains unknown, with online, print and issue dates kept separate. Harness Repair and D-Skill completed current-v1 historical-backlog review without version upgrades; the earlier D-Skill deferral was corrected because offline execution traces can supply feedback, and the correction history is retained. Three arXiv searches returned zero window records; five RSS feeds returned 57 with no new candidate identities; checks of 13 GitHub repositories found no window releases. S2 citations retained 280 window records but encountered rate limits and a timeout. The author route obtained no author-paper page, so missing coverage is unknown. All 2,090 canonical records were reconciled against raw sources, historical discoveries and review queues, with no eligible raw-source omissions or missing HF recommendation dates found. Other version differences and evidence gaps retain item-specific resumable states; retrieving a body is not completing its review. New DeepSeek generation requests: zero. The prior model-quality warning remains. This bulletin describes this collection-time snapshot, includes no papers newly published today, and does not claim that all sources were inactive throughout the day.

entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-17 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: This delayed collection and review bulletin was reviewed on Nov 18, not completed on Nov 17. A complete 41-paper HF board for Nov 17 was fetched on Nov 18 and reconciled by identity and recommendation date. Three-round scope review excludes all 41 from this topic, so this edition includes no new paper. The Sage S1.5/S2.1 naming conflict and the SPILLWAY version-number conflict remain recorded; scope exclusion does not resolve those source conflicts. The Nov 16 late board now contains 40 papers and is handled under its actual recommendation date. All 12 enabled sources were actually attempted on Nov 18 between 09:17 and 09:22 Asia/Shanghai. The strict source window contained 423 occurrences across 388 stable IDs and added 122 new records (103 papers and 19 posts). Seven historical issue paper candidates were separately verified and ingested, bringing total new records to 129 (110 papers and 19 posts), not 129 inclusions. Three arXiv queries returned zero window entries; the five RSS feeds returned 5, 6, 47, 7 and 0. Release checks succeeded for 13 GitHub repositories with no window releases. S2 citations retained 277 window occurrences across 246 IDs, but 46 requests included 15 rate limits and reached a 180-second cutoff. Author identity lookup succeeded but paper traversal was blocked by six rate limits; unvisited coverage remains unknown.

entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-21 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: This status bulletin was reviewed and published late on Nov 23, not collected on its edition date. The complete HF board for this edition returned zero on Nov 23. That is an observed board snapshot, not evidence that every source had no update. All 12 enabled sources were attempted on Nov 23 at 15:53–15:58 Asia/Shanghai. There were 4,684 raw occurrences across 4,416 stable IDs; 520 window occurrences across 471 IDs added 234 canonical records (213 papers and 21 posts). The three arXiv queries yielded 15, 17 and 2 window records; the five RSS feeds yielded 9, 7, 49, 7 and 0. Release queries succeeded for all 13 GitHub repositories with no window release. S2 citations made 47 requests including 19 rate limits and retained 262 window occurrences before the 180-second cutoff; authors made eight requests including six rate limits, with only partial identity lookup and unfinished paper traversal. Unvisited coverage remains unknown. Item-specific three-round review yields 29 inclusions (25 in delayed Nov 18–20 editions and four historical additions), 202 exclusions and three evidence deferrals. EVA-RSI needs a demonstrated Harness-edit chain, DailyBrick needs a deployed cross-configuration update, and the S2-only survey needs its full text. Six older external evidence gaps remain itemized. Historical global evaluation has not finished; recall is 0.892857 versus 0.90, without a threshold change or pass claim. Paid model requests and generation tokens are zero; scope review is not experimental replication.
